info.name: VTex Anti-fraud Provider Account Bulk Import API

items.docs:
Uploads a file for bulk import of Buyer Organizations, Cost Centers and Members. The uploaded file should be in `XLSX` format and have less than 50MB. For more information on the file structure and how to fill it out, access the [Bulk Import Spreadsheet](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/bulk-import-buyer-organizations-spreadsheet) guide.
